nodes.label: graphify Native CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: `graphify claude install` writes a persistent ## graphify section into the project's CLAUDE.md so Claude Code checks the graph before answering codebase questions and rebuilds it after code changes, without a manual /graphify invocation each session.

nodes.label: graphify Post-Commit Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit instead of running a background watcher and works with any editor; only re-runs AST extraction on changed code files (no LLM cost), and leaves doc/image changes for a manual --update since those need semantic re-extraction.

nodes.label: Work Memory / Reflect Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Tagging saved answers useful/dead_end/corrected lets `graphify reflect` build LESSONS.md so future sessions start from preferred sources and skip known dead ends instead of re-deriving them.

nodes.label: Whisper Transcription Pipeline
nodes.rationale: The host LLM composes its own one-sentence domain hint from existing god-node labels to prime Whisper's initial_prompt, avoiding a separate API call solely to generate that hint.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete confidence anchors (0.55/0.65/0.75/0.85/0.95) replace a continuous 0-1 scale because models were observed collapsing continuous guidance into a bimodal distribution (over 50% at 0.5, over 40% at 0.85+); discrete rubrics are followed more faithfully.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must match exactly what the AST extractor generates (full repo-relative path, every segment kept, joined by underscores, plus normalized entity name) so semantic and structural extraction merge onto the same node instead of creating orphan ghost-duplicates.

nodes.label: Opt-in Workplan Hub Pattern
